description:
Team AWACS combined clinical, pharmacy, business analysis, and software skills for astronaut health monitoring.

Noor (Medical Analyst) and Rahaf (Pharmacy Analyst) supplied prioritised user stories and clinical review to keep the tool safe and non-diagnostic. Brett (Business Analyst) structured requirements, prioritisation, and UAT across time zones. Jude (IT Developer) built the FreeBruff dashboard and Python/FastAPI layer with ranked alerts, baseline comparison, body map, and offline support.
